input.quote: Licensee acknowledges that the grant of the license set forth in this Section is a non-exclusive license and that the Licensor shall have the right to use and to license to other parties the Licensed Technology for any purpose and in any manner as Licensor may determine in its sole discretion.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no exclusive-dealing or "sole supplier" obligation on us. The licence is expressly non-exclusive (p0030, p0043, and the recitals/Article IV), and nothing requires the Licensee to route all Spot FX volume through the E-Path FX Platform, to meet minimum volumes, or to refrain from licensing or using a competing platform; the volume bands in Article V are pricing tiers only. The restrictions in Article II and Article VI limit onward distribution and disclosure of Licensor's own Licensed Technology (standard IP scope controls), not our freedom to source from other suppliers. The Article XXII "Right of First Refusal" (p0139) is a change-of-control/asset-sale ROFR in favour of Licensor, not a supply exclusivity or requirements commitment, so it does not engage this rule (any concern with it belongs to the change-of-control rule). This meets the preferred position — no exclusivity binding the Customer — so no redline is warranted.
